changes.text: In November 2025, the Company obtained exclusive commercial rights to the VitaGuard™ Minimal Residual Disease platform in the ASEAN region through a licensing arrangement with Fidelion Diagnostics.
changes.evidence: In November 2025, the Company completed a Share Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement with Fidelion Diagnostics Pte. Ltd., a Singapore company ("Fidelion"). The parties also entered into an Intellectual Property License Agreement, pursuant to which the Company obtained exclusive commercial rights to the VitaGuard™ Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) platform in the ASEAN region, on a perpetual and exclusive basis.
